theme_archetype.name: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Ethnic Wear Variant
theme_archetype.description: Warm, festive, premium-but-approachable. Balances a trusted, grounded feel (ivory base) with the celebratory energy of Indian ethnic fashion (jewel-toned accents). Not cold or minimal, not cluttered. Rooted in heritage.

usage_rules.h1: font-['Rozha_One'] text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-[#2B211E] tracking-normal leading-tight
usage_rules.h2: font-['Rozha_One'] text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl text-[#2B211E] tracking-normal

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Create breathing room for high-quality product images. Mobile-first layout with thumb-friendly CTA positioning.
spacing_and_layout.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-8

buttons.primary: bg-[#7E1F35] text-[#FAF6F0] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-['Jost'] font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-[#631728]
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-[#7E1F35] text-[#7E1F35] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-['Jost'] font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-[#7E1F35] hover:text-[#FAF6F0]
buttons.whatsapp: fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform z-50 flex items-center justify-center

cards.image: w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105

inputs.base: w-full border-b border-[#2B211E]/20 bg-transparent py-2 font-['Jost'] text-[#2B211E] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#7E1F35] transition-colors rounded-none placeholder:text-[#6B5B55]/70

background_textures.mandala_overlay: absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.03] mix-blend-multiply pointer-events-none bg-[url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1711552466487-ac9afb5528cb')] bg-repeat

motion_and_interaction.hover_effects: Product images subtly scale up (105%) over 700ms on hover. Secondary image reveals on desktop hover via opacity crossfade.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Soft fade in for main content areas.
motion_and_interaction.urgency_indicators: Subtle pulsing red/maroon dot next to 'Only 3 left' text to grab attention without screaming.

home.hero: Navratri hero section taking 80vh. Full bleed background image with 40% dark gradient overlay. Rozha One headline, countdown timer component, Primary CTA. Center aligned content.
home.categories: Bento grid of categories (Suits, Kurtis, Lehengas) with deep jewel tone overlays.
home.why_rari: A horizontal strip/marquee with textured ivory background. 'Premium Fabric • Honest Pricing • Surat to your Door'.
home.bestsellers: Grid of 4-8 products with quick-add functionality.
home.instagram: Grid of 4 square images mimicking IG feed with '@rari.ethnic' handle.

shop.layout: Mobile-first filter drawer on the left/top. Product grid on the right.
shop.filters: Collapsible accordions for Price, Size, Color, Fabric, Occasion.
shop.card_interaction: On desktop, hover reveals alternate image. On mobile, clear tap targets.

product_detail.layout: Split layout on desktop (Sticky info right, scrolling images left). Carousel on mobile.
product_detail.actions: Full width 'Add to Cart' (Primary), followed by 'Ask about this piece on WhatsApp' (Secondary outline with WhatsApp icon).
product_detail.details: Accordion sections for Size Chart, Fabric Care, Fit Notes.
product_detail.urgency: Text '🔥 High Demand: Only [N] left in stock' in #7E1F35.

navratri_landing.vibe: Richer, more saturated. Use #DCA537 (Mustard) and #7E1F35 (Maroon) heavily.
navratri_landing.content: Countdown timer at top. Categorized sections ('Garba Ready', 'Day 1-9 Color Guide').

cart_checkout.payment: Prominent 'Cash on Delivery' selection. Clear breakdown of total pricing (₹).

hero_and_banners.description: Red and gold bridal outfit, perfect for Navratri Hero banner.
Woman in red bridal outfit, great for category header.

textures.description: Mandala floral pattern for background overlays

instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_libraries: Use Lucide-React for generic icons, but use react-icons for the WhatsApp icon (FaWhatsapp).
instructions_to_main_agent.responsiveness: Ensure mobile checkout is fully optimized. Sticky Add to Cart button on mobile PDP.
instructions_to_main_agent.brand_tone: Do not use generic SaaS placeholders. Incorporate the provided media URLs heavily. If missing a product image, reuse the ones provided. Never use via.placeholder.com.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Inject the provided Google Fonts URL into the main HTML or via @import in CSS. Apply Rozha One strictly to headings to give the brand its ethnic identity.
